entities.summary: Collin Thomas Balester is an American former professional baseball player. A pitcher, he played in Major League Baseball (MLB) from 2008 to 2015 for the Washington Nationals, Detroit Tigers, and Cincinnati Reds. Balester also played in the KBO League for the Samsung Lions.
